text:
Type: extendable square dining table in dark wood
Use: everyday dining, hosting more guests when extended; dining room, kitchen, family room
Style: classic, traditional, contemporary
Materials: brown-black stained wood veneer, pull-out leaves stored under the top
Colors: dark brown-black
Shape: square top, deep plain apron, extension leaves sliding out at both ends, four thick square legs, grounded and solid, medium visual weight
Feel: dependable, warm, sober, sturdy
Goes with: black or white chairs, light walls, warm wood floors, cream textiles; classic dining rooms or modern family kitchens
